mechanism: Both drugs can cause photosensitivity and vertigo/dizziness; minocycline may increase hydroxychloroquine levels through modest CYP3A4 inhibition and both accumulate in tissues with potential for additive toxicity.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity reactions, vestibular symptoms, and pigmentation changes; counsel on sun protection and report dizziness or balance problems; consider alternative antibiotics if significant adverse effects emerge.
